title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $401.99 on iRobot Roomba Plus 405
excerpt: From picking up dust to scrubbing away stains, this robot vacuum takes complete care of your floors.
content_html:
SAVE OVER $400: As of July 29, the iRobot Roomba Plus 405 is on sale for $398 at Amazon. That's a 50% discount on the list price.

Credit: iRobot

$398 at Amazon
$799.99 Save $401.99

iRobot is one of the best-known names in robot vacuums, and for good reason. The brand is synonymous with effective devices that automate one of life's most arduous chores.

If you've been looking for a good deal before purchasing your own iRobot, Amazon has a great deal on the iRobot Roomba Plus 405. Not only is it currently 50% off at $398 (a total discount of $401.99), but it is also the best-ever price for this vacuum.

This is a robot vacuum and mop combo designed to tackle everyday dirt and spills. It uses DualClean Mop Pads, SmartScrub technology, a multi-surface rubber brush, and an edge-sweeping brush to clean across different floor types. And for deeper floor cleaning, the spinning DualClean Mop Pads apply downward pressure, and SmartScrub technology gives more thorough scrubbing to help remove tougher messes.

It also works with very little effort from you. For example, its navigation is handled by ClearView LiDAR navigation. This allows the vacuum to map your home quickly, plan efficient cleaning routes, and avoid obstacles, while sensors help prevent falls down stairs. Also, it has an AutoWash Dock that automatically empties the dustbin for up to 75 days, washes and dries the mop pads, and keeps them refreshed to ensure efficient mopping.

这是一款机器人吸尘器和拖把组合，旨在解决日常污垢和溢出物。 它采用 DualClean 拖把垫、SmartScrub 技术、多表面橡胶刷和边缘清扫刷来清洁不同类型的地板。 为了更深入地清洁地板，旋转的 DualClean 拖把垫会施加向下的压力，而 SmartScrub 技术可提供更彻底的擦洗，以帮助清除更严重的污渍。

您只需付出很少的努力即可实现它。 例如，其导航由 ClearView LiDAR 导航处理。 这使得真空吸尘器可以快速绘制您的房屋地图，规划有效的清洁路线并避开障碍物，而传感器则有助于防止从楼梯上摔下来。 此外，它还有一个 AutoWash Dock，可以自动清空垃圾箱长达 75 天，清洗和干燥拖把垫，并保持清洁，以确保高效拖地。
